## Standalone app

| System | Download |
|---|---|
| Linux | `NXConvert-<version>-linux-x64.AppImage` or `-linux-arm64.AppImage` (`chmod +x`, then run) |
| macOS | `NXConvert-<version>-macos.dmg` (drag to Applications; first launch: right-click, Open) |
| Windows | `NXConvert-<version>-windows-x64.exe` |

The app is also the command-line tool: run it with `--help`.

## Developer packages

`nxformat-<version>-<platform>` archives: C API (`nxformat.h`), C++17 reader
headers, shared and static libraries, CMake config. `nxformat-xmake-<version>.zip`
is the xmake repository. `SHA256SUMS` lists every file.
